deviations: final MoE = Exp 6a unchanged; its full-frame ALE outputs are shared with the other arms (computed once per frame)

router-free receivers are NEW: ale_* (ALE always on), chain_* (+ post-ALE pulse erasure = the MoE's cascade-A step, always on), rule_* (rho-gated ALE + pulse erasure = frame-mode twin of the v5 streaming 'rule' receiver)
primary baseline = the router-free receiver with the lowest mean BER over every single-jammer, clean and compound cell (conservative)
ALE work = full-frame ALE passes per frame; the MoE's override test on a 'none'/'broadband' verdict counts as one pass
new compound BR+PU (broadband+pulse), seeds seed_base + t + 4*2000; the first four compounds keep Exp 6a seeds
claim: Frame mode: against the strongest router-free receiver (rule_sw), the router lowers BER in 7 of 20 (type or compound) x protocol cells, is worse in 5, and is not resolved in the rest; the frame-mode MoE runs 0.82 full-frame ALE passes per frame on average (router-free: 1.00), because the override test runs the ALE on every 'none'/'broadband' verdict.
